description: Opérateurs gestionnaires du Réseau d'Assainissement is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Exploitants du Réseau d'Assainissement Modes de gestion, opérateurs et dates de contrat des gestionnaires de l'assainissement. Les données sont mises à jour à chaque échéance de contrat. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Service. Its keywords are assainissement, eaux usées. The portal shows 93 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
